label: EU-ehds-2025 Article 69

obligations.text: A health data access body shall not provide a response to a health data request in any other format and the health data user shall have no access to the electronic health data used to provide that response.
A health data request as referred to in paragraph 1 shall include the following information:
The health data access body shall assess if the health data request is complete and take into account the risks referred to in Article 68(2).

The health data access body shall assess the health data request within three months of receipt of the request and, where possible, subsequently provide the response to the health data user within a further three months.
